headlines.title: Pappas questions whether Americans are feeling Trump's 'golden age' after primary win
headlines.description: Rep. Chris Pappas asked voters if they feel they are living in President Trump’s "golden age" after his projected win in New Hampshire's Democratic Senate primary.

headlines.title: Conflicting court rulings leave Missouri’s congressional map in limbo
headlines.description: Republicans rushed to the high court after the Missouri Supreme Court ruled the state could not use the redrawn map, which was designed to eliminate one Democratic-held seat, this year.

headlines.title: Oil hits $100 a barrel for first time in months as Middle East conflict intensifies again
headlines.description: The price of oil breached the $100 threshold on Wednesday for the first time in months, as new flare-ups in the United States’ war with Iran stoked fresh concern for global energy markets.

headlines.title: Iran attacks American warships and base after U.S. sinks five Iranian tankers
headlines.description: They’re the latest tit-for-tat strikes as Washington and Tehran lurch back toward fighting during more than six months of war.

headlines.title: Trump escalates Canada trade war, moving to ban imports of some motorcycles, dairy and alcohol
headlines.description: As the U.S.-Canadian relationship severely deteriorates, the White House says the import bans will go into effect in about three weeks.

headlines.title: Trump says firefighters near ground zero carried him to safety ‘right after’ 9/11 attacks
headlines.description: Trump, who said that he was “down there right after this happened,” later said on Truth Social that he wasn’t at the World Trade Center “on the same day as the collapse, but shortly thereafter.”

headlines.title: Everything to know about your favorite team this NFL season
headlines.description: NFL Kickoff Guide, powered by NBC Sports breaks down the most important stats, storylines and changes to know for all 32 teams heading into the 2026 season.

headlines.title: Halloween Chocolatey Eyeballs Candy Recalled Over Allergy Risks
headlines.description: New Jersey candy company Little Temptations has recalled their popular “chocolatey eyeballs” because of undeclared milk allergens. The candy is sold at major retailers including Marshalls, TJ Maxx, and Home Goods in 13 states.
